cells.defect: No privilege-separated per-pane packet accounting backend exists. This host disables unprivileged BPF, grants the application neither CAP_BPF nor CAP_NET_ADMIN, and user-systemd IPAccounting reports no data because its BPF firewall cannot run as root. TCP socket diagnostics omit UDP, closed-socket traffic, and complete lifecycle attribution, so they cannot satisfy this cell.

The product does not yet create or adopt per-pane cgroups, and no controlled journey proves exact process-tree and byte attribution across descendants, unrelated traffic, cgroup migration, network namespaces, and disposable containers.
